configs.title: CONFIG FOR MOBILE USER [STABLE] - VENYX
configs.desc:
MJ ULTIMATE AFK FARM [VENYX]

⚠️ READ THIS FIRST
Always join the server with the best connection (lowest ping).
Some features are OFF by default. Turn them on if you need them.

STEALING
- Auto Steal [ON]: teleport, anti guard, steal from players
- Min value 1B, sells cheapest egg when bag is full
- Zones: Enchanted Forest, Light Dark, Titan Temple

FARM
- Auto Place Egg [OFF]: smallest first, min 1B (for fusing)
- Auto Hatch [OFF]: hatches all eggs in the pen
- Auto Mutate [OFF]: all mutations, 10B and above, Divine, Secret, Eternal
- Auto Sell Egg [OFF]: sells eggs below 1B
- Auto Favorite [ON]: pets worth 100B and above, plus equipped pets
- Auto Fuse [OFF]: lowest rarity and value first, ejects odd pets
- Priority [ON]: treadmill and fishing rotate every day

HALLOWEEN
- Auto Steal Eggs [ON]: instant, min 1B
- Auto Fishing [ON]: Spot 1 (changeable)
- Auto Farm Monsters [ON]: Blood Moon only, most tokens first, teleport
- Auto Phantom Express [ON]: auto boss, max speed, auto buy Spectral
- Auto Pumpkin Moon [ON]: max speed, teleport, auto buy egg

EVENTS
- Auto Shooting Star [ON]
- Auto Butterfly Bloom [ON]: chase mode, smart trade, auto craft
- All Admin Abuse events [ON]

EXTRAS
-

configs.title: V1.2 MJ ULTIMATE AFK FARM [VENYX]
configs.desc:
MJ ULTIMATE AFK FARM [VENYX]

⚠️ READ THIS FIRST
Always join the server with the best connection (lowest ping).
Raw eggs worth 50B/s and above are kept safe.

STEALING
- Auto Steal [ON]: teleport to egg, anti guard, steals from other players
- Steals Cosmic, Eternal, Secret and Divine eggs, min 100M/s, best value first
- Zones: Enchanted Forest, Light Dark, Titan Temple, Cherry Blossom, Cosmic
- Instant Steal [ON]

FARM
- Auto Place Egg [ON]: Cosmic, Eternal, Secret only, night only, best value first
- Auto Hatch [ON]: Eternal and Secret only, equips best pets
- Auto Mutate [ON]: 10B/s and above, best value first, uses Fractured, Scrambled, Enchanted, Nitro, Spectral
- Auto Sell Egg [ON]: eggs below 5B/s (Cosmic and below)
- Auto Favorite [ON]: pets 10B/s and above
- Auto Fuse [ON]: below 10B/s, lowest value first, ejects odd pets
- Auto Claim: offline cash and index rewards

HALLOWEEN
- Auto Steal Halloween Eggs [ON]: instant, min 100M/s, Secret, Eternal, Divine
- Auto Fishing [ON]: Spot 1, plus Ghost Dog quest
- Farm Monsters While Fishing [ON]
- Auto Farm Monsters [ON]: most tokens first, teleport
- Auto Phantom Express [ON]: trade souls, vacuum boss, teleport
- Auto Pumpkin Moon [ON]: teleport, auto buy Dimension Egg

EVENTS
- Auto Shooting Star [ON]
- Auto Butterfly Bloom [ON]: chase mode, rarest first
- Auto Wisp Quest [ON]
- Admin Abuse [ON]: Capture The Egg, Minigame Eggs, Cursed Island Wars

PLAYER
- Speed Boost, God Mode, Hit Aura
- Anti Ragdoll, Ignore Traps, Instant Prompts, Anti AFK

SYSTEM
- Low Graphics, black background, FPS cap 60
- Auto rejoin on kick, auto load script
- Server hop to least players
- Discord webhook (add your own URL)

QUICK BARS
- Bar 1: Farm (steal, place, hatch, mutate, fuse, favorite)
- Bar 2: Player (speed, hit aura, steal from players)
- Bar 3: Treadmill and Fishing
- Bar 4: Halloween and Admin Abuse events

KNOWN ISSUES
Fishing and stealing at the same time in the main area may cause a little lag.
A few small bugs are still around, so good luck!

configs.title: MJ ULTIMATE AFK FARM [VENYX]
configs.desc:
⚠️ READ THIS FIRST
Always join the server with the best connection (lowest ping).

This config runs everything automatically. It keeps raw eggs worth 50B/s and above safe, and it never places, hatches or fuses Divine eggs.

FEATURES
- Auto Steal (Teleport): Cosmic, Secret, Eternal, and Divine eggs (100M/s and above)
- Auto Steal from other players (with Anti Guard)
- Instant Steal (Admin Abuse)
- Auto Sell: eggs below 5B/s (Cosmic and below)
- Auto Halloween Event
- Auto Pumpkin Moon
- Auto Farm Monsters
- Auto Phantom Express (trade souls, vacuum Ghouler boss)
- Auto Buy Halloween Dimension Egg
- Auto Steal Halloween Eggs
- Auto Fishing and Ghost Dog Quest
- Auto Shooting Star
- Auto Butterfly Bloom
- Auto Wisp Quest
- Auto Place Egg (no Divine)
- Auto Treadmill (via priority rotation)
- Auto Hatch & Equip Best Pets (no Divine)
- Auto Fuse Machine (no Divine)
- Auto Favorite (10B/s and above)
- Auto Apply Mutation (10B/s and above)
- Admin Abuse: Capture The Egg, Minigame Eggs, Cursed Island Wars
- Easy Quick Bar

HOW IT WORKS
1. Auto Steal: steals Cosmic, Secret, Eternal, and Divine eggs from the selected zones.
2. Auto Place Egg: places Cosmic, Eternal, and Secret eggs only, and only at night. Never Divine.
3. Auto Hatch: hatches Eternal and Secret eggs only, then equips the best pets.
4. Auto Fuse Machine: fuses Cosmic, Eternal, and Secret pets below 10B/s. Never Divine.
5. Auto Favorite and Auto Mutation: apply only to eggs and pets worth 10B/s and above (Fractured, Scrambled, Enchanted, Nitro, and Spectral).
6. Quick Bar: quick and easy access to your main toggles whenever you need them.

KNOWN ISSUES
Fishing and stealing at the same time in the main area may cause a little lag. A few small bugs are still around, so good luck!
